name: Nezrimaja mgla
source:
The story takes place in the mid-1980s. A young student named Konstantin has just finished his second semester and now has to complete a summer work assignment. His choices are limited: either spend a week digging potatoes under the scorching sun or go to a camp to look after children. As you might guess, the protagonist chooses the latter and heads to a camp under the supervision of Olga Dmitrievna.

First and foremost, Kostya will have to learn what responsibility truly means. Taking care of children is hard work, and the full weight of this duty is something the protagonist has yet to experience. Each child is a unique individual with their own story that Kostya must understand in order to unite the group. But that’s only the beginning, at some point, Kostya uncovers a terrible secret surrounding the camp Sovenok. He would be faced with a task: to dispel the unseen darkness.
translation:
故事发生在20世纪80年代中期。一位名叫康斯坦丁的年轻学生刚刚完成第二学期的学习，现在必须完成暑期作业。他的选择很有限：要么花一周时间在烈日下挖土豆，要么去营地照顾孩子。正如你可能猜到的那样，主角选择了后者，并在奥尔加·德米特里耶芙娜 (Olga Dmitrievna) 的监督下前往营地。

首先，克斯特亚必须了解责任的真正含义。照顾孩子是一项艰苦的工作，而这一责任的全部重量是主角尚未经历过的。每个孩子都是一个独特的个体，有自己的故事，克斯特亚必须理解这些故事才能团结整个团队。但这只是开始，在某个时刻，克斯特亚发现了围绕索维诺克营地的可怕秘密。他将面临一项任务：驱散看不见的黑暗。
